{{Quote|Your arrival isn't on my schedule. Let me see your identification papers. "<br />"You don't need to see my identification."<br />"This one thinks he's a Jedi. And why ''wouldn't'' I need to see your identification.''"<br />"''Because you're dead.|Stormtrooper to Tyber Zann, shortly before his death|<ref name="FoC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>}}
A '''[[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]''' was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] with a task to guard a gas refinery. He and his fellow stormtrooper guarded a landing platform, when [[Tyber Zann]] staged a [[Ground Battle on Bespin|robbery]] at the area. Zann dropped down in a stolen [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] at the landing platform the two soldiers were guarding. The stormtrooper noticed that this wasn't on his schedule, and demanded that Zann provide identification. Tyber said the trooper did not need to see his identification. The stormtrooper joked that Tyber was pretending to be a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and asked for what reason did Tyber not need to provide identification. Zann calmly stated the trooper didn't need to because he was dead, as a cloaked [[Urai Fen]] instantly killed him, allowing Tyber to shoot the other stormtrooper.
